narrative_purpose: Shows the moment a body stops being a pile of accreted material and becomes a structured world: metal descending, rock floating, gases escaping upward to form the first atmosphere.
subject: A cutaway of a young world entirely molten inside. Through the glowing interior, dozens of bright metallic droplets of varying size are visibly descending toward a dense forming core at the centre, leaving faint trails behind them. The upper interior, drained of metal, is paler and less bright. At the surface, a thin dark crust is cracking into plates, and from several of the cracks thin dark plumes of gas rise upward into a hazy new atmosphere.
scene: The world hangs alone against dark space with faint distant stars. A thin hazy shell of newly vented gas surrounds it, thickest just above the venting cracks.
camera: Three-quarter view of the cutaway, the cut face angled toward the viewer so both the descending droplets and the surface venting are visible at once.
light: Self-luminous interior: hottest and brightest at the forming core, cooling upward and outward; the thin crust silhouetted dark against the glow beneath it; the rising gas plumes lit from below.
palette: Warm amber and ember interior confined inside the body, bright near-white metallic droplets, dark stone-grey crust, cool teal-indigo venting haze, void-indigo space.
style: Painterly naturalist cross-section plate, textured brushwork, soft-edged internal boundaries.
detail_level: High on the descending droplets and the cracked crust; softer in the deep interior glow.
composition: The world fills about three-quarters of the frame, centre-right, cut face toward the viewer. Dark empty space to the left for callouts.
consistency_notes: This is Pandora before it is Pandora - no forests, no oceans, no bioluminescence. The warm palette is licensed here because the subject is genuinely molten; keep it inside the body, with the surrounding space and haze cool.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no leader lines, no grid, no diagram chrome, no vegetation, no oceans, no bioluminescence, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
